description_en: Queries the CIDR blocks of an anti-DDoS diversion instance
kebab_example: aliyun ddosdiversion query-net-list --sale-id ddos_diversion_public_cn-xxxxxxxxxxxxx --net 192.168.XX.XX/24 --biz-mode netflow-auto --main-net 192.168.XX.XX/22 --page 1 --num 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryNetList

parameters.description_en: The ID of the anti-DDoS diversion instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the anti-DDoS diversion instance
parameters.name: sale_id

parameters.description_en:
The CIDR block of the anti-DDoS diversion instance.

> If no extended CIDR blocks are configured for the anti-DDoS diversion instance, this parameter specifies the CIDR block of the instance. If an extended CIDR block is configured for the anti-DDoS diversion instance, this parameter specifies the extended CIDR block that is configured for the instance. If this parameter is specified, the MainNet parameter is required.
parameters.description_zh:
代播实例的网段。
